daily_1.name: Daily Task: Deployment
daily_1.description: Complete raid(s) on any map (including failed attempts).

daily_5.name: Daily Task: Combat
daily_5.description: Eliminate a specific number of enemies.

daily_12.name: Daily Task: Collection
objectives: Turn in Medical supplies Found In Raid

daily_13.name: Daily Task: Collection
objectives: Turn in Household Items Found In Raid

daily_14.name: Daily Task: Collection
objectives: Turn in Batteries Items Found In Raid

ark_36.name: Coastal Pursuit
ark_36.description:
We've been getting reports of unknown armed groups showing up on the north side of the island. Things at the [Dam] have settled down for now, so we can finally turn our attention up there.
We don't know much yet. Start with the [Resort Area]. There's been activity around [Rua Algasol], the [Victoria Golden Hotel], and the [east wing of WhiteSail Hospital].
Check all three locations, get a sense of what's happening in the area, then extract safely.
objectives: Reach the east of White Sails Hospital

ark_37.name: A Different Angle
ark_37.description:
Those armed men you saw don't look local. They seem more like scavenger gangs from off the island. We still don't know what they're doing here, so we'd better gather more information before making any moves.
I set up a rangefinding scope near the [security booth at WhiteSail Hospital] a while back, but that position isn't much use for surveillance anymore.
Find it and relocate it to the [back yard of Seafoam Scoops]. It should still be useful from there.
objectives: Place in the Seafoam Scoops' backyard

ark_38.name: A Closer Look
ark_38.description:
A lot's been happening around the [Resort Area] lately, and Hyder Police has moved some of its people into the area. There are a couple of police cars parked near [Silverwave Bank] now.
We don't mean them any trouble, but being ARK means we can't exactly walk up and start asking questions. I'd rather know what the police are up to before we get involved with them.
Do me a favor and head to [Silverwave Bank]. Get photos of the [police car at the front] and the [police car at the back]. For now, it's better if we keep our distance.
objectives: Take photo of a police car (Front of the bank)
Take photo of a police car (Back of the bank)

ark_39.name: Keeping the Peace
ark_39.description:
Looks like those outsider scavengers have been causing plenty of trouble around the [Resort Area]. They're taking advantage of all the chaos on the island, and if we leave them alone, things are only going to get worse.
We've seen them around the [fire station], the [eastern military camp], and [Halif Travel]. Check all three locations and clear out some of the scavengers while you're there. Don't let them keep gathering in force.

ark_40.name: The Big Ones
ark_40.description:
Things around the [Resort Area] are getting more complicated. Someone's spotted a few BMPs out there, and those aren't exactly the kind of vehicles you just stumble across on an island like this.
Take some trackers and tag every BMP you find. I've already sent the trackers to you, so check your mailbox before you head out. One per vehicle is enough.

ark_41.name: Crime Scene
ark_41.description:
Those scavenger gangs have been stirring up trouble all over the [Resort Area], and I've heard they're looking for some valuable jewelry. The [bank vault] was breached recently, and there's a good chance they had something to do with it.
We need to follow the trail they left behind. Start with the [breach in the vault], then check the [construction site], [junkyard], and [Workers Dorm].
Keep an eye out for useful intel along the way and bring some back to me. Maybe it'll tell us what they're planning next—or who's really calling the shots.
objectives: Turn in Intel Items Found In Raid

ark_42.name: ★ Judgment
ark_42.description:
We've finished going through the intel you brought back. Turns out those people causing trouble around the [Resort Area] do have someone calling the shots.
His name's Butcher, and he's at the [Workers Dorm]. The bank job and everything else that's been happening around here seem to lead back to him. If we let his people keep running wild, they're only going to cause more trouble.
Head to the [Workers Dorm] and take care of Butcher. Make sure you've got the right man—he's covered in tattoos, with black-and-white skull paint on his face.

ark_43.name: Going Underground
ark_43.description:
Nicely done. I think you're ready to take on somewhere a lot more dangerous.
The [Metro Area] is a maze, and M.I.C.A.'s map won't be much help down there. Keep your eyes open and pay attention to where you're going.
Start with the [hound statue at the station], the [public bath on the lower levels], and the [medical base deeper inside]. Get familiar with the layout.
Oh, and to enter the [Metro Area], put a Metro Ticket onto the conveyor belt beside the mission terminal.
objectives: Find the Underground Medical Base's Hall

ark_44.name: Undercurrents
ark_44.description:
Scavengers have been gathering in the [Metro Area] too. With all those twisting tunnels and supplies still lying around, it's a perfect place for them to dig in.
The ones underground are a lot tougher than what you've been dealing with on the surface. Go clear some of them out before they do any more damage to the facilities, then extract safely.

ark_45.name: Twists and Turns
ark_45.description:
The hardest part about operating in the [Metro Area] is getting around. Those tunnels twist all over the place, and it's easy to take a wrong turn when you're trying to extract.
I've heard there are hidden extraction routes near the [restroom] and the [warehouse]. Since you've already spent some time down there, find both of them and make a few more runs so you get used to navigating underground.
M.I.C.A.'s compass still works down there, so use it if you lose your bearings.
objectives: Find the Secret Passage in the Restroom of the Metro
Find the Secret Passage in the Warehouse of the Metro

reward.item_name: AUG A3 M1 5.56x45mm assault rifle Optic edition

ark_46.name: Heavy Armor Below
ark_46.description:
Some of the intel you brought back suggests the [Metro Area] was converted into a military base at some point. There are BMPs parked down there too.
Take some trackers and tag the BMPs. Make sure you've got the right vehicles—the ones marked with red crosses are medical vehicles, not our targets.
objectives: Mark BMP Tank without Medical signs

ark_47.name: Show of Force: M4A1
ark_47.description:
Have you used the M4A1 family before? They're built for close- to mid-range fighting, with a good balance of firepower, portability, and modularity.
Use an M4A1-series weapon to [take down some enemies] and show me you know how to make the most of it.

ark_48.name: Show of Force: AUG
ark_48.description:
Let's switch things up again. The AUG is compact and accurate, and it'll feel a little different from the rifles you've used so far.
Take one into the field and use an AUG-series weapon against some enemies. The more weapons you're comfortable with, the easier it'll be to find something that works for you when you're operating in unfamiliar territory.

ark_49.name: ★ Lord of the Underground
ark_49.description:
Looks like we were right. The scavengers in the [Metro Area] haven't been acting on their own. Someone's been organizing them from behind the scenes this whole time. The man in charge goes by Ironclad.
After everything we've done down there, he's lost a lot of his people, but he's still got a few loyalists around him.
Head into the [Metro Area], find Ironclad, and put an end to this threat for good.

ark_50.name: Redeployment
ark_50.description:
Someone recently destroyed the cameras I deployed in the Suburbs, and now I've completely lost visibility on those locations.
There are still some spare cameras in the warehouse beside the Office Building. Retrieve them and redeploy them on the [barrel near the security office entrance at the Office Building warehouse] and at the [food truck pickup window] beside Altibuy.
objectives: Place at Foodtruck; On the warehouse barrel

ark_51.name: Field Photography
ark_51.description:
The cameras we just brought back online caught some movement. Looks like a lot of scavengers have been operating around [Trupiks Mall]. Problem is, the cameras only cover the outside. We still don't know what's happening inside.
I need some pictures from inside the mall. Get shots of the [burger place on the first floor], the [repair shop on the second floor], and the [outdoor store on the third floor]. Let's see what's really going on in there.
objectives: Find the Burger Store on the 1F of TRUPIK'S Mall
Find the Repair Store on the 2F of TRUPIK'S Mall
Find the Out-door gear store on the 3F of TRUPIK'S Mall
Take photo of the Burger store sign
Take photo of the Repair store sign
Take photo of the Out-door gear store sign

ark_52.name: Secret Contact
ark_52.description:
I've got something that needs handling, and I need someone I can trust. My contact left some intel behind on three discs.
Head to the [Weather Outpost], [Turbine Field], and [Dock Pylon]. Find the [ARK discs] at each location and bring all three back to me.

ark_53.name: The Bait
ark_53.description:
Something in those photos doesn't add up. There's ARK gear in [Trupiks Mall], and signs of ARK activity—but none of it shows up in our operation records.
Look for a few [discs] while you're out in the field. They can turn up as random finds, so collect enough and plant them in the [gym locker room] and the [two security rooms] inside [Trupiks Mall].
Once they're in place, leave them alone. I want to see who's been making moves behind our backs.
objectives: Arrive the Gym locker room on the 3F of Trupiks Mall
Arrive surveillance room 1 on the 1F of Trupiks Mall
Arrive surveillance room 2 on the 1F of Trupiks Mall

ark_54.name: ★ Traitor
ark_54.description:
We've got a fix on the ARK traitor. His name's Ravager, and he's behind the unregistered supplies and activity we've been seeing around [Trupiks Mall]. At this point, there's no question this was more than some unauthorized side operation. He's turned against ARK.
Ravager is on the [roof of Trupiks Mall]. We don't know how much he's already leaked, and we can't let him keep going. Find him and put an end to this.
objectives: Find the Rooftop of TRUPIK'S Mall

ark_55.name: Baseball Cams
ark_55.description:
That's enough of the [Suburbs] for now. Next, we're heading back to the [Dam]. Before ARK pulled out, we set up some surveillance equipment around the [docks]. Two of the cameras were disguised as baseballs. I need you to recover them and see what they might've recorded.
One's in the [dock office]. The other's in the [small shop next door].

reward.item_name: AR-15 M4 Handle Scope Rail mount

ark_56.name: Transport and Maintenance
ark_56.description:
That broken bridge at the [Dam] used to be an important transport route. We should check what shape the supports are in. Head underneath and mark the [east bridge support] and the [west bridge support]. It'll make things easier when we send someone back to inspect them later.
Also, bring three 30-round MP5 magazines and leave them in the [container by the bridge]. My contact will pick them up. You just need to drop them off.
objectives: Put magazine Mag MP5 30rnd in place

ark_57.name: Patrol
ark_57.description:
Thanks for the help, but there are still parts of the [Dam Area] we don't have a clear picture of. Head northeast to [Clifton] and check out the [grocery store] and [barbershop], then swing south to the [toll booth].
While you're at it, get more familiar with the extraction routes. Extract from the [Dam Area] twice.
objectives: Arrive the grocery store in Clifton

reward.item_name: AR-15 M4 Handle Scope Rail mount

ark_58.name: Factory Tanks
ark_58.description:
You should know your way around a tracker by now. This time, I've got something a little trickier for you.
There are three green tanks in [Factory Area A] at the [Dam]. Looks like they're storing some kind of chemicals. Tag all of them. I need them marked for a recovery operation later.
objectives: Mark the Green Storage Tank 1 in Factory A Zone
Mark the Green Storage Tank 2 in Factory A Zone
Mark the Green Storage Tank 3 in Factory A Zone

ark_59.name: ★ Silver Skull
ark_59.description:
There's one problem at the [Dam] we've been putting off. Some tough bastard has holed up in the [Electrical Room], and everyone we've sent after him has come up short.
You know the [Dam] well enough by now, so I'm putting this one on you. Head to the [Electrical Room], find the target, and take him out. It's not an easy place to get in or out of, so watch your surroundings.

reward.item_name: AUG A3 M1 5.56x45mm assault rifle CQB edition

ark_60.name: Show of Force: M16A2
ark_60.description:
The training before was just about getting you familiar with different weapons. This time, I want to raise the bar a little. The M16A2 doesn't give you a lot of fancy extras, which makes it perfect for testing the fundamentals.
Use it to take down some targets. I want to see you handle both the iron sights and the four-power optic—close range, long range, you should be comfortable with both.
Finish this, and I'll give you an AR308. It's a .308, so you're getting more stopping power—and a rifle that asks a little more from the shooter. Consider it something for people who've actually learned their way around a rifle.

ark_61.name: Show of Force: MK17
ark_61.description:
After all that training, you've had your hands on quite a few different rifles. Next up is the MK17. It's accurate and handles well at medium to long range, so the [Resort Area] should be a good place to put it through its paces.
Take an MK17 into the [Resort Area] and use it against a few enemies. Don't just worry about the numbers—try it at different ranges and get a feel for the rifle.
Finish this one and I've got a G3 AK4 for you to try next. It'll feel a little different from the rifles you've used so far. You'll see what I mean once you get your hands on it.

ark_1.name: Handshake
ark_1.description:
Hey, you new here? I'm Tommy, with ARK Industries.
Things on the island have gotten a lot worse. Scavengers are everywhere, and they don't exactly go easy on strangers.
Head out and take a few of them down. Let's see if you've got what it takes to make it out here.
ark_1.tips: Check the 'Extraction' tab in the menu or use the M.I.C.A. map to find extraction points.

ark_62.name: Northern Camp Recon
ark_62.description:
Not bad. Looks like you know how to handle yourself.
If you're planning to stick around, you'd better get familiar with the area. There's a [Northern Camp] in the [Suburbs]. Head over there and get the lay of the land.

ark_3.name: Intelligence Gathering
ark_3.description:
Good timing. I've got something I could use your help with.
The island's a mess right now, and the more intel we have, the better. Keep an eye out for anything useful and bring it back to me.
objectives: Turn in Intel Items Found In Raid

reward.item_name: MP5A4 9x19mm sub-machine gun Suppressed Walther edition

ark_63.name: Before the Chaos
ark_63.description:
I've got something I need you to pick up.
Before everything went to hell on the island, one of our sergeants was vacationing at [Palm Hill]. He had to leave in a hurry and left an ARK file behind. The house is right by the tennis court.
[Palm Hill] isn't exactly the peaceful getaway it used to be. Find the file and bring it back before it ends up in someone else's hands.

ark_64.name: Preparation
ark_64.description:
The people around the market all have their own connections. We help each other out from time to time, so don't be surprised if some of them come to you with work later on.
Anyway, back to business. ARK left two tracker prototypes at [Altibuy] in the [Suburbs]. One's in the [restroom], and the other's up on the [roof]—you'll need to take a ladder to get there.
Have a good look around and bring both of them back.

ark_65.name: Where Did the Trucks Go
ark_65.description:
There are several ARK transport trucks near [Trupiks Mall] in the [Suburbs]. We need to confirm their locations and figure out where they're headed. Good chance to put those trackers you brought back to use.
Hold a tracker near the target. Once you see the prompt, let go and it'll attach itself. One per truck is enough.
Go tag a few of those trucks. Good luck out there.

reward.item_name: AR-15 M4 Handle Scope Rail mount

ark_66.name: Another Option
ark_66.description:
Things on this island can change fast. I want you to get comfortable with different types of weapons, so you'll have more options when things go sideways.
We'll start with SMGs. Take an MP5 out and use it against some scavengers. Get a feel for how it handles.

ark_67.name: End of the Line
ark_67.description:
We've got a hit from those trucks you tagged. The tracking data shows they're all heading toward the [motel].
I want to know what's waiting for us there. Head over and take a look around. Find out what's going on.

ark_68.name: Better Safe Than Sorry
ark_68.description:
Things are only going to get more dangerous from here. Can't hurt to get some practice with another weapon.
This time, we're moving on to rifles. The AR15 is light, easy to customize, and pretty straightforward to use. Take one into the field and get some real combat experience with it.

ark_69.name: Tracks of the Wolf
ark_69.description:
A name keeps coming up in the intel we've been getting: Iron Wolf. Looks like he's been organizing the scavengers around here, but we still don't know exactly where he's holed up.
We've seen signs of his people around the [drive-in theater] and the [Office Building]. Check both locations and clear out any scavengers you find nearby while you're there.

ark_70.name: ★ Wolf Hunt
ark_70.description:
We've pinned down Iron Wolf's location. He and his men have taken over [Hyder Police Station] and turned it into their base.
He's got a lot of influence among the scavengers around here, and more of them are starting to rally around him. If we let this go on, those scattered scavengers are going to turn into a real organized fighting force.
Hit [Hyder Police Station] before they get fully established and take Iron Wolf out. Once it's done, get out of there safely. Don't give his people a chance to hit back.
objectives: Reach the Hyder Town Police Station
Eliminate Iron Wolf in Police Station

forge_5.name: Business Is Business
forge_5.description:
Heard about the robbery in the [Resort Area]? Plenty of people over there are looking for somewhere to move dirty money and stolen goods. Why would I pass up business like that?
Take this [secret contact phone] and hide it inside the [wall fountain at Rua Algasol]. Someone will know how to reach me from there.
If you lose the mission item, come back to me and buy another one.
objectives: Place in the wall fountain in Rua Algasol
forge_5.tips: Small fountain on wall in Rua Algasol.

forge_6.name: Car Smuggling
forge_6.description:
You know Hovolt? I love the way they design their cars. There's a [Hovolt dealership in the Resort Area], and I'd like to get my hands on a few.
Before that, though, I need you to take some [photos] so I know exactly what's there.
Get a picture of [each color variant in the showroom].
objectives: Take photo of a black Hovolt car
Take photo of a yellow Hovolt car
Take photo of a blue Hovolt car
Take photo of a red Hovolt car
forge_6.tips: Car dealership located east side by tunnel extract. All required cars are nearby.

forge_7.name: Easy Pickings
forge_7.description:
I hear that gang up north is obsessed with some legendary jewel. Apparently everything else, no matter how valuable, is beneath them.
Who actually believes stories like that?
Go check the [Flea Market in the Resort Area]. If they've ignored any [antiques], I'll happily take them off their hands.
objectives: Turn in Antique Tea Plate - Yang
Turn in Antique Tea Plate - Yin

forge_8.name: Right Under Their Nose
forge_8.description:
Hydertown's police seem pretty busy dealing with the gangs. Funny thing is, one of them came to me looking to move something valuable he'd quietly taken for himself.
Conveniently, I've got enough cash hidden around town to make the deal.
Collect the money from the [garbage trucks near the Fire Department], [Garbage Station], and [Workers Dorm] in the [Resort Area], then leave it by the [fountain near Halif Voyages].

forge_10.name: Courier
forge_10.description:
One of my people got killed while moving merchandise through the [Resort Area]. The shipment's time-sensitive, and right now you're the only person I can think of who can finish the job, my friend.
Pick up the cargo from the [supermarket on -1F of Crimson Luxe], then deliver it to the [east skybridge], [west connector], and [hospital connector].

forge_12.name: ★ Deal Breaker
forge_12.description:
Remember that cop who came to me looking to move some stolen goods? That bastard never intended to hand the goods over. He was planning to rip me off from the start. Business runs on trust, and if he's going to break the rules, then he needs to pay for it.
He's running with his people around [Silverwave Bank] now. Find the one in charge, [Barricade], and teach him a lesson for me.
Be careful. He's probably expecting trouble. You shouldn't have much trouble picking him out—he's dressed head to toe in black, all wrapped up like he's got something to hide, and wearing [SWAT armor and a helmet].
forge_12.tips: SWAT boss located at the Bank main entrance.(Not Bonecrusher in yellow helmet)

forge_31.name: Collector
forge_31.description:
Collecting trends have changed again. Now everyone's after character figures.
I used to think they were just decorations, but I'll admit it—collecting things is strangely satisfying. Watching a shelf slowly fill up gets addictive.
Bring me a [complete set of character figures], including the [secret variant]. I've heard that one's worth more. Supposedly it's the [gold-painted version].
forge_31.tips: Reward not worth it. Exchange gold figurine for Endgame equipment in official discord.

forge_32.name: Final Collector's Set
forge_32.description:
I'd show you my collection if I could, but the display's still missing a few pieces, and I can't stand leaving a collection incomplete.
Maybe you can help me finish the last set. Find me a [complete set of Contractors game discs]. There are [four versions] in total: [standard and deluxe editions of Contractors], and [standard and deluxe editions of Showdown].
objectives: Turn in Contractors Game Disc Collector's Edition

forge_30.name: Virtual Reality
forge_30.description:
Heard there are [four VR prototypes] somewhere on this island. I need you to track them down. To the right buyer, they're collector's pieces.
My information's limited. I know the [first prototype] is at the [Drive-in Theater in the Suburb Area]. The [other three] were lost somewhere in the [Dam Area], [Smuggling Tunnel], and [Metro Area].
Keep an eye out for them while you're exploring.
objectives: Find the VR Headset in Suburb area
Find the VR Headset in Dam area
Find the VR Headset in Metro area
Find VR Headset in Smuggling Tunnel

forge_26.name: Business Expansion
forge_26.description:
I want you to try extracting through several different routes.
This is scouting work for a client. Don't worry, it's all preparation for what comes next.
Extract safely near the [Drive-in Theater in the Suburb Area], the [Convoy in the Dam Area], and the [ambulance in the Resort Area].
objectives: Extract from White Sail Hospital West

forge_28.name: Worth More Than Gold
forge_28.description:
That hacker certainly took her time.
There wasn't much useful data on the drive, and most of it was buried under junk files. But she managed to pull out three things that matter: a strange [launch program], a password, and a [location].
I'll work on figuring out how the program and password fit together. You head to the [Control Room in the Metro Area] and look for a [special briefcase].

forge_29.name: Pleasure Doing Business
forge_29.description:
You're back. Want to know what that thing you brought me actually is?
First, that program we found earlier is a missile launch program. And that case isn't an ordinary computer either. The program from the hard drive has to be loaded into it, then the password entered, before the system can run.
Something like this is worth more than money. Ha! You've become my most efficient—and most trustworthy—business partner.
Here, take this [key]. Go to the [locked room in the sewers of the Metro Area]. Whatever's inside is yours. Take as much as you can carry. Consider it a reward for being my favorite partner.
objectives: Find the Sewer Area Back Room

forge_15.name: Cleaning House
forge_15.description:
I've got something that needs handling, and from what I hear, this is exactly your kind of work.
One of my people stole a few [gold bars] from me. I don't need the money, but I don't tolerate anyone helping themselves to what's mine. That's betrayal.
My people have already cornered him inside [Trupiks Mall]. Your job is simple: get down to the [room on B1] and do whatever it takes to [bring my gold back].
forge_15.tips: Located in the center of the Mall on -1F, in the room below escalator stairs.

forge_16.name: Plan Ahead: Safehouses
forge_16.description:
Staying alert is part of doing business. I've got a few [safehouses in the Suburb Area] that I use for storage and transfers, and I need to know they're still intact and ready whenever I need them.
Check the [water tower north of Altibuy], the [green tent in the plaza north of Trupiks], and the [small building north of the mall, past the overpass].
Inspect them carefully, then extract.
objectives: Find the water tower near the AltiBuy
Find the green tent in the TRUPIKS plaza
forge_16.tips: water tower (more of a tank than a tower) 50M north of altibuy in the backyard of the 3 story house, green tent located in front of mall northeast corner by overpass, cabin located north of mall just past overpass before tunnel

forge_17.name: Fire Hazard
forge_17.description:
My hiding spots are usually flawless. Usually. A few of them are at risk of being damaged by accident.
I need you to inspect the area and mark the sites with [trackers] so I can keep an eye on my merchandise.
Head to the [farm area] and mark the [tall round silos to the north]. And while you're there, bring back any [flammable materials] nearby. Better not leave those lying around.
objectives: Turn in Combustible Items Found In Raid
forge_17.tips: These are *not* barns, they are tall silos.

forge_19.name: Real Gold: Supply
forge_19.description:
Thanks to you, I've had a lot more clients coming my way lately. Unfortunately, some rich people have expensive tastes, and gold keeps showing up on their shopping lists.
Demand jumped faster than I could prepare the supply. So try your luck and bring me a [gold bar].

forge_22.name: Real Gold: Counterfeit
forge_22.description:
I compared the bar you brought back with the ones we recovered earlier. Turns out mine were fake.
Now I really want my gold back. That traitor left behind a contact message mentioning someone posing as a forklift driver somewhere in the [Dam Area].
Go mark the [forklifts at the Dock] and the [forklifts at the Old Factory]. I need more information.
objectives: Mark the forklift 1 in Old Factory
Mark the forklift 2 in Old Factory

forge_25.name: Real Gold: The Riddle
forge_25.description:
All this trouble over a few gold bars. I should've put a few holes in that bastard when I had the chance.
Anyway, we found another message under one of the forklifts. It included a location and a riddle.
The gold is somewhere in the [Dam Area]. Here's the clue:
[Sea breeze beside you, iron arm to the sky, true gold waits where clouds drift by.]
Sounds like we need to look up. Go get my [gold bars] back.
forge_25.tips: Climb to the top of the crane. Acrophobia is a thing.

forge_27.name: Top Hacker
forge_27.description:
While checking through some merchandise, I found a heavily encrypted [hard drive]. The security on this thing is serious. That usually means serious money.
I'll need help from a hacker friend of mine. Problem is, she's a hopeless gaming addict, so I need something that'll convince her to make time for me.
Find me some [limited-edition game discs]. Try the [Building B area at the Old Factory in the Dam Area] and the [container stacks at the bottom of the Dam]. We might get lucky there.

forge_13.name: Small Things Add Up: Old Phones
forge_13.description:
Let's move on to another kind of collectible: [old phones].
They may look like junk to you, but there's potential value inside them—information.
Business is all about knowing something the other guy doesn't. The more information you have, the more options you have. And you'd be surprised how much money there is in selling information by itself.

forge_14.name: Small Things Add Up: Cameras
forge_14.description:
Seen any valuable antiques while you've been exploring?
Funny timing—I've got clients looking for used [cameras]. Apparently vintage photography is the latest trend.
I'm not about to let an opportunity like that pass. Try your luck and bring me a few. Maybe I can ride this little trend all the way to the bank.

forge_33.name: Handheld Gamer
forge_33.description:
Hey, people still have old game systems lying around here? Now that's nostalgic.
When I was a kid, owning one of those made me the king of the neighborhood.
Now you've got me wanting to play again. Find me a [handheld game system] and [four different game cartridges].

forge_34.name: Customer First
forge_34.description:
New face? Tommy mentioned you. Name's Maximilian. I can get my hands on plenty of good stuff, but if you want to do business with me, you'll have to handle a few things first.
As it happens, one of my clients is looking for a solid-gold ornament. There's a secret tunnel under the [Dam] called the [Rat Hole], and a [golden globe] is hidden inside. Sounds exactly like his kind of thing.
Go in, find it, and come out the other side. Bring me the merchandise, and we'll call that our first deal.
objectives: Arrive the entrance to the Rat Hole
Arrive the exit of the Rat Hole

forge_35.name: Seeing Is Believing
forge_35.description:
There's a crashed plane over by the [Dam]. Everyone else is picking through what the passengers left behind, but I'm more interested in the [engine nacelles on the wings]. If those big things are still salvageable, they could be worth serious money.
Head over to the [Crash Site] and take pictures of both [engine nacelles] for me. I need to see if they're still worth recovering.
While you're there, look around for some [household goods] and bring them back too. I've got buyers looking for that sort of thing right now, so no reason to waste the trip.
objectives: Turn in Household Items Found In Raid

forge_36.name: Rumor Has It
forge_36.description:
Word is, somebody was moving something valuable out of the [Lumberyard in the Dam Area], but it sounds like they got held up by a load of fallen timber somewhere near the [Field Clinic].
I don't make decisions based on rumors, so I want to know if there's any truth to it. Follow the road, find the trucks, and [mark] their locations for me.
And bring back some [electronics] while you're out there. That market's been good lately—the newer the gear, the easier it is to sell.
objectives: Turn in Electric Items Found In Raid

forge_37.name: Worth the Price
forge_37.description:
I've got a [golden cup] stashed at the [Wyeth Farmhouse in the Suburbs]. A client couldn't pay what he owed me, so he settled the debt with that instead.
Now I've finally got someone interested in buying it. Go bring it back. No point letting good merchandise gather dust when it could be making money.
objectives: Arrive the Bedroom in Wyeth farmhouse

forge_38.name: Plan Ahead
forge_38.description:
These scavengers are getting out of hand. They've been hanging around my transport routes far too often.
I need a backup route. Check the [checkpoint], [parking lot], and [lookout tower] in the [Suburbs] and see what the situation looks like along the way.
Once I have your report, I'll decide whether the route's worth using.

forge_39.name: Back Route
forge_39.description:
Find the [bunker west of TRUPIK Mall, near the canal] and make sure it's safe, then [extract from the area].
Here, take the [bunker key]. You've proven yourself capable enough by now, so you can try using the bunker itself as an extraction route.

forge_40.name: Small Things Add Up: Notebooks
forge_40.description:
Partner, I've got an easy errand for you. Don't worry—low risk, decent return.
While you're out exploring, pick up some [notebooks] for me.
You'd be surprised how often business opportunities are hidden in things people scribble down without thinking. Every now and then, one of these notebooks contains something a client might pay for.

forge_41.name: Small Things Add Up: Tapes
forge_41.description:
I've noticed people on this island still use cassette tapes sometimes. That's impressively retro.
Funny enough, I found an old [cassette player] buried in the back of my storage room, and the thing still works.
So now I need some [cassette tapes]. Bring me a few. Let's see if there's anything interesting recorded on them.

forge_42.name: Rumors
forge_42.description:
Hey, partner. How've you been?
One of my middlemen brought me something interesting. There's a new group on the island asking around about the [Dam's energy facilities]. Could mean a little extra business for us.
Apparently they left behind a few [intel phones]. I've marked the locations. Go bring them back.
As for what's on them? We'll find out once they're in my hands.
objectives: Find the phone at the crash site
Find the phone in the house opposite Ellie's Shop
Find the phone on the old car by the cemetery

forge_43.name: Sizing Them Up
forge_43.description:
Those phones paid off.
The newcomers with the leopard patches call themselves Leopard Global Security—LGS. Well-equipped private military outfit.
I don't particularly care why they're here. What I care about is whether they're going to interfere with my business.
Some of their people recently clashed with scavengers in the [B1 warehouse area of Trupiks Mall]. A few bodies were left behind.
Go see if there's anything valuable on them.
objectives: Take photo of the LGS operative body #1
Take photo of the LGS operative body #2
Take photo of the LGS operative body #3

forge_44.name: Casting the Net
forge_44.description:
I've heard about a few places LGS has been using. I want to keep an eye on them for a while.
The [black truck near the main entrance of the Dam Factory] and the [vehicle in the Resort bank parking lot] are both good targets.
Plant the [trackers].
I've sent them to your mailbox.
Be careful. Nobody likes being watched.
objectives: Mark the truck at the front gate of the Dam Factory
Mark the truck at the rear gate of the Dam Factory
Mark the black car at the Resort Bank
Mark the blue car at the Resort Bank

forge_45.name: Clearing the Noise
forge_45.description:
The tracker data is getting interesting.
I'm starting to see how LGS operates, but the scavengers have been so active lately that they're muddying the picture.
Clear out the noise—[Dam Area], [Resort Area], [Suburb Area]. Don't skip any of them.
Use a [pump-action shotgun]. I'd rather the blame point toward LGS. The gun's in your mailbox. Lose it, buy another from Tommy.
Get it done and get back.
objectives: Pump Shotgun: Eliminate targets in Dam Area
Pump Shotgun: Eliminate targets in Suburb Area
Pump Shotgun: Eliminate targets in Resort Area

preReward.item_name: M870 12ga pump action shotgun SHORTY edition

forge_46.name: Paper Trail
forge_46.description:
LGS uses encrypted communications, but even careful people leave a paper trail.
Check the [Vent Room #2 in the Smuggling Tunnel] and the [bank in the Resort Area].
If you find any [LGS internal documents], bring all of them back.
And deal with the scavengers in the tunnel while you're there. They've been making a mess of my smuggling routes lately.

forge_47.name: Stir the Pot
forge_47.description:
If they care that much about their information, maybe we should help spread it around.
Clear out the scavengers nearby first.
Then plant those [phones containing LGS intel] at the marked locations.
Put them at the [police station] and the [restaurant].
After that, we sit back and enjoy the show.
objectives: Place in the police briefing room
Place at the diner front desk

forge_48.name: Tracking the Golden Lion
forge_48.description:
Word is, someone hid something near the [Dam Factory] before everything went bad—a [golden lion statue].
You know me. I have a weakness for that kind of thing, so I'm asking you to make another trip.
There isn't much to go on, and the factory's been searched more than once since then.
But the statue should still be somewhere inside.
LGS has also been sending more elite troops into the [Dam Area]. If you run into them, deal with them. They'll only become a problem later.
objectives: Eliminate LGS Lv4 in Dam Area
Eliminate LGS Lv5 in Dam Area

ntg_10.name: Road Maintenance
ntg_10.description:
Their coordinates are pointing toward the [Smuggling Tunnel] now.
Sounds like LGS has quite a presence down there too.
I don't care what they're doing.
Remove anyone blocking the way.
Don't let them interfere with my business.

forge_49.name: Loose Ends
forge_49.description:
Time to tie up the loose ends.
The LGS troops still underground are their best. Be careful when you engage them.
And don't forget the [LGS medal in the bathroom]. Bring it back to me.
I've got a feeling it'll be useful later.
objectives: Eliminate LGS Lv4 in Metro Area
Eliminate LGS Lv5 in Metro Area

gunsmith_1.name: Craftsmanship: Paint
gunsmith_1.description:
Ever thought about giving your weapons a new look?
I've got some spray paint here. You can use it at the [Paint Bench on the right side of the workshop] to customize the colors and patterns on your weapon parts.
Before that, though, I need you to bring me some [batteries] and [spray cans].
objectives: Turn in Batteries Items Found In Raid

gunsmith_3.name: Craftsmanship: Rebuild
gunsmith_3.description:
Pick up the [AR15 Hunter] from your mailbox and place it on the [rack at the Gunsmith Bench].
Store the parts from the mail in the inventory on the [conveyor belt beside the bench].
Then replace the AR15 Hunter's wooden [handguard], [grip], and [stock] with the three parts I sent you.
Bring me the modified rifle when you're finished.
objectives: Install M4 Factory original pistol grip

gunsmith_5.name: Craftsmanship: Assembly
gunsmith_5.description:
Replacing parts is one thing. Next, let's see how you do building a weapon from scratch.
I've sent you a full set of [1911 parts]. Pick them up, assemble them into a complete pistol at the [Gunsmith Bench], then bring me the finished weapon.

gunsmith_7.name: Craftsmanship: Adaptation
gunsmith_7.description:
Pick up the [G3] from your mailbox.
This build uses a different set of parts than the ones you've worked with so far. Follow the objective list and install the required components.
Bring me the finished weapon when you're done.

reward.item_name: G3 AR Buffer tube stock adapter

gunsmith_9.name: Modding Trial: M16
gunsmith_9.description:
Next one is the [M16].
I've already listed the parts I want on it. Install everything exactly as specified at the [Gunsmith Bench].
Bring me the completed build.
objectives: Install AR-15 M4 Handle Scope Rail mount

gunsmith_11.name: Modding Trial: G3
gunsmith_11.description:
This time, use a [G3].
The required parts are listed in the objective. Make sure each one is installed in the correct position.
Submit the finished weapon when you're done.

gunsmith_13.name: Modding Trial: M870
gunsmith_13.description:
Next is the [M870].
Install the required parts from the objective list, including the [PEQ 20-Rail Tactical Laser]. Check the build before you submit it.
Bring it to me when it's complete.

gunsmith_15.name: Modding Trial: SKS
gunsmith_15.description:
Last one in this set is the [SKS].
Install the [magazine], [tactical attachment], and the remaining required parts from the objective list.
Check the build carefully, then submit it.

gunsmith_17.name: Modding Trial: AK74N
gunsmith_17.description:
Take an [AK74N] to the [Gunsmith Bench].
Install the [magazine], [tactical attachment], and the other parts listed in the objective.
Once the build matches the requirements, submit it to me.

gunsmith_2.name: Workshop Interview
gunsmith_2.description:
I'm Anna. Johnny mentioned you. Said you're pretty good with your hands.
The base has power again, and the [Gunsmith Bench] is back online. Before I let you loose on it, I need to make sure you know what you're doing.
Install this [lower receiver]. Bring it to me when you're done.

gunsmith_4.name: Missing Part
gunsmith_4.description:
Basic handling looks fine. Want to build a gun of your own? Next up is the barrel.
ARK's reports mention [508 mm long barrels] showing up in the field from time to time. See if you can track one down.
If you come up empty, Tommy may have the same model for sale.

gunsmith_6.name: Craftsmanship
gunsmith_6.description:
You've got the barrel. Now we can put the whole thing together.
Head to the [Gunsmith Bench] and start with the [lower receiver]. Add the [upper receiver], [long barrel], [ACOG], and [suppressor]. Pick the tactical attachment yourself, as long as it helps with recoil.
Bring me the finished build when you're done.

gunsmith_8.name: Field Test
gunsmith_8.description:
Nice work on the build. Now I need you to take it into the field.
Word just came in that scavengers near the [burger restaurant on the first floor of the Suburb Mall] have been getting restless. Go deal with them and give that new rifle a proper test while you're at it.
objectives: Find the Burger Store on the 1F of TRUPIK'S Mall

gunsmith_10.name: Quick Aim
gunsmith_10.description: Even an old weapon can wreak havoc with an optic mounted on it. Use an AKS74UN lower receiver, then equip a rail mount and a Cobra sight. Submit it to me once it's assembled.

gunsmith_12.name: Tools of the Trade
gunsmith_12.description:
I've been doing some more work around the workshop lately, but I'm still short on a few basic tools.
There are two storage rooms marked [WH] in the east section of the [Smuggling Tunnel], and another one in the west section. Have a look around those rooms and bring back some [tool items] for me.
I trust your judgment.
objectives: Turn in Tools Items Found In Raid

gunsmith_14.name: Buying Access
gunsmith_14.description:
If we want to get inside this transport network and start pulling it apart, we may have to spend a little money first.
Go to the [guard booth near the south elevator in the Smuggling Tunnel] and pick up the [cash] I left there. Then place it at the marked drop points to pay off my contacts:
on the [forklift driver's seat below the Control Room], on the [wooden crate beside the camo box near the Dock], on the [crate being carried by the forklift inside the Warehouse], and on the [support frame in front of the steam pipe beside the South Elevator].
objectives: Find money at Southern tunnel post

gunsmith_16.name: Close Quarters
gunsmith_16.description:
You should know by now that the [Smuggling Tunnel] isn't exactly a peaceful place. Fighting indoors is different from fighting out in the open, and your weapon choice has to change with it.
Speaking of that, I want to see how you handle the [MP9]. Take one in and deal with the people holding the place.
They've earned what's coming to them, but make sure you come back safely, all right?

gunsmith_18.name: Surveillance Setup
gunsmith_18.description:
Tommy and I talked it over. The [Smuggling Tunnel] is one of the most dangerous areas on the island right now, and we still don't know enough about what goes on inside.
You can find three [cameras] in the office above the warehouse. Bring them down to the warehouse and install them at the three marked locations: on the first-floor wall behind the stairs, above the stack of wooden crates on the first floor, and on the wall at the end of the second-floor conveyor belt.
This matters for what comes next, so I'm counting on you.

gunsmith_19.name: Field Adaptation
gunsmith_19.description:
The cameras are already sending footage back. Another armed group has moved into the [Smuggling Tunnel]. They really don't want to let go of that place.
This time, switch to the [Malyuk]. Its layout is different from the rifles you've used so far. Take it in and deal with them.

gunsmith_20.name: Purge Protocol
gunsmith_20.description:
Before ARK pulled out, they prepared a purge protocol to destroy harmful data stored on terminals in the [Smuggling Tunnel]. They never finished the job, and the [floppy disks] containing the program were left behind.
The disks are scattered around: two are in the back room of the green torture room near the south elevator; one is inside the medical supply box on the RH-01 wall; and one is on the floor near the pillar in the middle of the stone-cave corridor.
The two marked terminals are in the second-floor office above the warehouse and in the second-floor room in the dock freight area, CARGO ZONE-01.
Find all four disks. Insert one into each [marked terminal], then bring the other two back to me. I need to verify what's actually on them.
objectives: Placement 2: The 2F corridor of Ventilation Room 1
Placement 1: the room on the 2F at Cargo Area 01

gunsmith_21.name: Keep the Way Clear
gunsmith_21.description:
Another armed group has taken over the deeper section of the [Smuggling Tunnel]. A few days ago, someone tried to pass through and had to turn back.
This may sound strange, but that route doesn't belong to them. We all need it kept open.
Use whatever weapon you prefer. There are a lot of them, so be ready for a tough fight and clear the route.

gunsmith_22.name: Blind Spot
gunsmith_22.description:
Remember those cameras you installed earlier? They've been a huge help, but the area around [The Cellar] has become a blind spot. I don't like leaving that much of the tunnel unseen.
The second batch of [cameras] is in the office above the warehouse. Pick them up, then install all three at the marked locations in [The Cellar]. Explore the whole floor and check the walls in the different rooms—you'll find suitable spots.
Get these online and you'll be doing both Tommy and me another big favor.

gunsmith_23.name: Encrypted Lead
gunsmith_23.description:
Tommy gave me a lead on [Vent Room #2]. Head down there and see what you can learn.
Separately, I'm looking for an [encrypted military USB drive]. It could turn up anywhere, so if you happen to find one during your travels, bring it back to me. The same goes for any other [intel items] you come across. There might be something in them I can use.
The exit from that section has to be opened manually. Make sure you trigger the [extraction switch] before you leave. Stay safe.
objectives: Find the ventilation room control panel
Turn in Intel Items Found In Raid

gunsmith_24.name: Communication Recovery
gunsmith_24.description:
The [USB drive] you brought back contains a transfer record. Before ARK evacuated, they left several [recorders] behind that were supposed to be delivered to the [room with the turtle].
Find all of the recorders and place them in the [cardboard box inside that room]. That's the handoff point listed in the record.
objectives: Find the White Recorder on the topfloor of dock office
Find the White Recorder in the red boat
Find the White Recorder in Ventilation Room 1
Find the White Recorder in control room

gunsmith_25.name: ★ Real Iron Wolf
gunsmith_25.description:
I finished listening to the recordings you brought back, and something doesn't add up.
The Iron Wolf in those recordings was already hiding in the [Smuggling Tunnel] before the chaos began, and he kept using other people to act for him on the surface. The man you met at the [police station] was probably just using his name.
The real Iron Wolf is still deep inside the [Smuggling Tunnel]. The impostor already managed to rally plenty of scavengers. Give the real one more time, and he'll be an even bigger problem than the last.
I need you to go back in, find him while we still have the chance, and finish this.
objectives: Eliminate Iron Wolf in Smuggling Tunnel
