ntg_34.name: Internal Communications
ntg_34.description:
I had someone hide a [USB drive] at the [Modern Apartments by the coast]. It contains some of NTG's internal communications from back then. Go pick it up and bring it back to me.
While you're there, take some [medicine] with you and leave it at the [agreed drop point inside the apartments]. Someone's still waiting for that delivery, so you might as well handle both while you're there.
objectives: Put medicine at the Crimson Luxe front desk

ntg_35.name: Where Did the Ambulances Go
ntg_35.description:
Things are a mess in the [Resort Area]. The hospital director asked if we could help locate some of the ambulances they've lost track of.
Use the [trackers] to mark a few [ambulances in the Resort Area].

ntg_36.name: Medicine from the East
ntg_36.description:
The hospital director told me that the [Resort Area] used to attract visitors from all over the world, so unusual remedies and medical formulas sometimes found their way here as well.
Apparently, a guest from the East once stayed in [Room 202 at the Victoria Golden Hotel], and left an [unusual medical formula] on the wall there. Go to [Room 202] and take a picture of it for me. The room should have [blue wallpaper].
objectives: Reach the Victoria golden hotel room 202
Take photo of the first medicine recipe
Take photo of the second medicine recipe

ntg_37.name: Foreign Remedy
ntg_37.description:
I've studied the formula. It shouldn't be too difficult to reproduce, but I'm missing a few ingredients.
There's a [private garden by the coast] where I left some herbs a while back. Could you retrieve them for me?
I'll also need [asthma medication], a [box of aspirin], and a [bottle of glucose]. Once I have everything, I can start preparing the remedy.

ntg_38.name: Signal Boost
ntg_38.description:
There's an old [memorial lighthouse on the western side of the Resort Area]. It hasn't been used in a long time, but the signal up there should still be good.
I've had someone leave a [radio] there. Head to the [two lookout towers near the ice cream shop] and retrieve the [signal boosters] from each one, then install them on the [radio at the top of the lighthouse].
Once you're done, [extract near the lighthouse] and come back.
objectives: Reach the Watchtower south of the Seafoam scoops
Reach the Watchtower north of the Seafoam scoops
Place on top of the lighthouse

ntg_39.name: Back Underground
ntg_39.description:
Have you been to the [Metro Area] yet? I actually know that place pretty well... I used to work down there.
I'd like to know what it's become since then. Could you take a few pictures for me? Get the [train controller in the Control Room], the [plants in the Treatment Area], and the [notice board in the Examination Room].
Seeing those should give me a good idea of how much the place has changed.
objectives: Take photo of plants in the medical base
Take photo of Bulletin Board in the Inspection Room

ntg_40.name: Way Out
ntg_40.description:
There's one more thing I need you to take care of in the [Metro]. Take this [chemical solution] deep into the [Medical Base] and leave it in the [sink in the Operating Room].
If you find any [medical supplies] along the way, bring back what you can.
Once you're done, use one of the [underground extraction points] to get out. I need to know that route is still usable.
objectives: Place in the Surgery room sink
Turn in Medical supplies Found In Raid

ntg_29.name: Covering the Tracks
ntg_29.description:
There are still a few things in the [Metro Medical Base] that NTG couldn't take with them during the evacuation. Some of them... would be better off not falling into anyone else's hands.
My [medical bag] should still be inside. Bring it back for me. And there are also some... [body bags]. Mark their locations while you're there.
I'll figure out what to do about the rest.
ntg_29.tips: Bodies and medical bag are on the lowest level.

ntg_41.name: Damning Evidence
ntg_41.description:
There have been reports of some horrific traces of medical experimentation in the [Smuggling Tunnel]. From what people have described, the scene is brutal. But there's something about the methods used there that sounds disturbingly familiar—like NTG's work.
I need you to investigate the [Lab area in the northern Smuggling Tunnel] and take some pictures for me.

ntg_43.name: ★ Mercy, Once More
ntg_43.description:
The scavengers in the [Smuggling Tunnel] call him Mince... but he was actually my mentor when I worked for NTG. He treated me like his own daughter.
Now he's lost his mind. Maybe whatever happened on this island drove him mad.
I want you to put an end to his suffering. Please.

ntg_45.name: Medicine Delivery II
ntg_45.description:
A few scavengers out there on their own managed to get in touch with me. They'd like to order some medicine, and I need you to make the deliveries.
These are the agreed drop-off points. Once you arrive, find the [cardboard box] and [place the medicine inside]:
• [the crane on the roof of the Construction Site in the Dam Area]
• [the hut with the satellite dish inside the Dock in the Dam Area]
• [the Italian Restaurant on B1 of Crimson Luxe in the Resort Area]
If you lose any of the mission items, come back to me and you can purchase replacements.
objectives: Arrive the satellite radar room at the Dock
Arrive the Construction Site's tower crane

ntg_46.name: Forgotten Records
ntg_46.description:
There are still a few NTG investigation reports scattered around the island. I'd like you to recover another batch for me.
You'll find them at:
• [Crown Oak on the second floor of Trupiks Mall in the Suburb Area]
• [inside the crashed truck below the Dry Valley in the Dam Area]
• [inside the restroom at the Medical Base on the lowest level of the Metro Area]
objectives: Find NTG Medical Report Dam Accident Truck

ark_4.name: Lost and Found
ark_4.description:
There's something I've been putting off dealing with. While I was trying to get away earlier, I ran into a group of scavengers who took some of my supplies.
I know their hideout is somewhere in the [Dam Area]. Go to the [Raider Camp] and recover my [medicine]. They're crafty—they like hiding valuables up high around the camp.
Once you have it, [extract through the nearby extraction point].
ark_4.tips: The phone is in a small room on the second floor of the office building, which is near the motel.

ntg_47.name: A Small Kindness
ntg_47.description:
Johnny mentioned that travelers still pass through [Dam Area] from time to time. We have a little medicine left over from what you recovered last time, so I'd like to leave some [bandages] there for civilians in need.
I've marked a suitable spot in [Dam Area]. Go there and leave some bandages. Maybe they'll help an injured civilian passing through someday.

ntg_48.name: Shadows of the Past
ntg_48.description:
We've managed with scavenged supplies and temporary caches so far, but that's not a long-term solution. If I'm going to get a proper medical area running, I need to know what infrastructure NTG left behind.
A few medical investigation reports were left behind when NTG evacuated. They contain records of samples collected on the island and observations made at the time. I'd like to go through them again.
I know some are still in the [Dam Area]: one inside the [wooden house next to the Logging Site], and another sitting on a [brown crate near the Plane Wreck]. Could you bring them back for me?

ntg_49.name: Repurposed Landmarks
ntg_49.description:
There are still a few places west of the [Dam] that I'd like to investigate, but we don't know enough about that area yet.
There are several abandoned [transmission towers south of the Dry Valley]. They haven't worked in years, but their locations could still be useful as reference points. Mark those towers for me first.
I've sent the [trackers] to your mailbox. Don't forget to pick them up before you leave.
objectives: Mark pylons south of the riverbed 1
Mark pylons south of the riverbed 2
Mark pylons south of the riverbed 3
Mark pylons south of the riverbed 4
Mark pylons south of the riverbed 5
Mark pylons south of the riverbed 6

ntg_50.name: Missing Pieces
ntg_50.description:
Some of the information in those reports still doesn't add up, but a few entries mention the [western inlet tower at the Dam] and the [Old Factory].
There's a [map in the room above the western inlet tower], and another [map on the wall in Building D of the Old Factory]. Take a picture of each for me. I'd like to compare them side by side—maybe they'll fill in some of what's missing from the reports.
I've prepared a [mission phone] for you. Don't forget to take it with you.
objectives: Arrive the Old Factory D zone

ntg_51.name: ★ Power Obstruction
ntg_51.description:
I compared the two maps you photographed, and I think I've found the last thing keeping the medical area from coming fully online.
[Building D at the Old Factory] controls part of the local power infrastructure connected to the equipment we're trying to restore. Unfortunately, a group of Scavengers has taken over the area, and their leader is holding the building. As long as he's there, we can't get close enough to the equipment.
Could you take care of him for me? Once he's out of the way, I should be able to restore power to the medical area and bring the rest of the equipment online.

ntg_52.name: Leftover Supplies
ntg_52.description:
I've started making plans for a proper medical area, but getting it running will take more than what we have here.

There used to be a wealthy resident at the [Villa in the southeast Suburbs], so there may still be plenty worth salvaging there. The [Supply Station east of the Villa] and the [Substation west of the Auto Repair Shop] are worth checking too.

Search those places for me. Anything useful we recover now will make the setup easier later.
objectives: Arrive the substation west of the Auto Repair Shop

ntg_53.name: Emergency Cache
ntg_53.description:
After looking over the places you checked, one thing is pretty clear: medical supplies are hard to come by in the Suburbs. So I'd like to leave a few emergency supplies there ahead of time.
The [tunnel near the Motel] and the [locked room on the second floor of the Office Building] should both work. Place the [suture kits] at the locations I've marked.
There are usually scavengers around the tunnel, so please be careful on your way in.
objectives: Arrive the locked room on the 2F of the Office Building
Put Suturing Instrument R2 in place

ntg_18.name: Private Practice
ntg_18.description:
I'm collecting medical supplies from the field for testing, but I don't have enough samples yet.
When I visited [Palm Hill in the Suburb Area], I came across a private clinic called [Dr. Blue's]. There should still be some [medkits] there. Could you bring them back for me?
The clinic can be a little hard to find. It's on the [second floor above a detective agency].

ntg_54.name: Laid to Rest
ntg_54.description:
One of my colleagues from NTG has gone missing. The last time we spoke, he said he was looking for research samples near [Wyeth Farm]. I haven't heard from him since.
Take this [phone] and search the [farm]. He mentioned the [cellar], so I'd start there. If you find anything, take pictures and bring them back to me. I need to know what happened to him.
objectives: Capture the corpse in Wyeth farm

ntg_55.name: Toxicology Sample Recovery
ntg_55.description:
Some of my colleague's research samples are still stored in the [warehouse at Trupiks Mall] and the [Motel]. I need you to recover the [chemical samples] for me.
One is inside a [blue container in the mall warehouse]. The other is in [Room 206 at the Motel]. Be careful—the substances may be toxic.

ntg_7.name: Trading Information
ntg_7.description:
Using the radio you recovered earlier, I managed to contact the director of [WhiteSail Hospital in the Resort Area]. I've agreed to provide him with some assistance, and in return, he'll share information that may be useful to us.
Take the [copper wire] and [spark plugs] to the [hidden room in the west wing of WhiteSail Hospital] and leave them there.
objectives: Reach the west of White Sails Hospital
ntg_7.tips: Drop the [X-NAX](https://www.exfil-zone-assistant.app/items/taskitem_placement_maggie_medicine) in the box at the Modern Apartment reception. [Pink USB](https://www.exfil-zone-assistant.app/items/taskitem_placement_maggie_usb) is there too.

ntg_56.name: First Contact
ntg_56.description:
Hi, I'm Maggie, from NTG. A lot of people were stranded here when everything fell apart on the island. Looks like you and I are no exception.
It's not exactly safe out there, and I haven't gone far from here in quite a while. I heard there may still be some medical supplies near the [Valley Pylon] in [Dam Area] that NTG couldn't take with them during the evacuation.
Could you make the trip for me? There have been quite a few scavengers in the area lately. If you run into any, please take care of them.
objectives: Find the launch site at [Valley Pylon]

ntg_1.name: Short on Supplies
ntg_1.description:
Thank you. It sounds like things out there are even worse than I thought.
I'm starting to run low on medical supplies here. There's a [Field Clinic north of the Dam] where medical supplies should be easier to find.
Could you gather some more for me? With things the way they are, it doesn't hurt to keep a little extra on hand.
objectives: Turn in Medical supplies Found In Raid

ntg_57.name: Old Aid Station
ntg_57.description:
There used to be a temporary medical station near the windmills in [Clifton], but the old records only give a rough location.
Could you go confirm it for me? Find the [two windmills] and mark each one with a tracker. That way, if we need to use the area again, I'll have an exact reference to pass along.
I've sent the [trackers] to your mailbox. Don't forget to pick them up before you leave.

ntg_58.name: Medical Journal
ntg_58.description:
There's one more thing I could use your help with. Things were chaotic when I arrived here, and I left my [medical journal] at a [campfire site in the Valley], somewhere around the U-shaped area between [Valley Pylon] and [Camp #10].
It contains notes I've compiled on medications, dosages, and quite a few records from past treatments. I'll need to refer to a lot of it if I'm going to get the medical area here properly organized.
Could you bring it back for me? Once I have those records again, I can finally start putting the medical area in order.

ntg_59.name: Repurposing Equipment
ntg_59.description:
I've taken a look at the medical equipment here, and a few of the machines need replacement parts. Finding exact matches probably isn't realistic anymore, but fortunately, I can substitute some common electronic components.
Could you keep an eye out for [household electronics] and [batteries]? You can find them all over the island, so there's no need to make a special trip. Just pick some up while you're out exploring.
Once we've got enough, I'll see if I can get those machines working properly again.
objectives: Turn in Electric Items Found In Raid
Turn in Batteries Items Found In Raid

ntg_60.name: Borrowed and Returned
ntg_60.description:
There's something else I still haven't managed to recover. When I left the northern part of the [Dam Area], I left a [camera] behind at the [Firewatch Cabin].
Johnny lent it to me, and it still has quite a few photos from my work on it. I don't really like the thought of leaving it out there.
If you happen to be in the area, could you bring it back for me? I really should return it to him.

ntg_61.name: Dock Investigation
ntg_61.description:
I've been meaning to look into the [Dock north of the Dam]. There are still some [red-and-black ARK cargo containers] there, and Tommy seems pretty interested in them too.
Could you make a trip out there for me? Find the containers and mark them with the [trackers]. I'd like to get a better idea of what's going on there.
I've sent the trackers to your mailbox. Don't forget to pick them up before you leave.

ntg_62.name: Reestablishing Contact
ntg_62.description:
Johnny mentioned that there's a [hidden room inside Ellie's Shop in Clifton], and there may still be a working [radio] inside.
If it still works, I might finally have a chance to get back in touch with NTG. I've been cut off from them ever since everything happened on the island. I don't even know how the others are doing.
Could you search [Ellie's Shop] and bring the radio back? I've sent you the [shop key] and a [large backpack]. Don't forget to pick them up from your mailbox before you leave.
objectives: Arrive the hidden room in Ellie's Shop

regiment_23.name: Taste of Life: Sake
regiment_23.description:
You know the [Smuggling Tunnel] has always been a favorite gathering place for smugglers and black-market traders. Goods from all over pass through there.
So I'll bet there's some good Asian liquor down there that even I haven't tried yet.
Go find me some [sake].
regiment_23.tips: White house in farm area on Suburbs. Mark one of the huge wine barrels in basement on the SW side. Dry wine bottle in kitchen sink on ground level. Both extracts are north of the white farmhouse.

regiment_36.name: Paparazzi Rebellion
regiment_36.description:
That tunnel sounds like a fun place. I hear those self-important bastards even put up skull scarecrows as warnings!
So naturally, we're going to do exactly what they don't want. Head into the [Smuggling Tunnel] and take pictures of a few [No Photography signs] and [skull scarecrows].
objectives: Capture the 'No Photo' Sign 1 on Northeast
Capture the 'No Photo' Sign 2 at Water Gate
Capture the 'No Photo' Sign 3 at Water Gate

regiment_28.name: Movie Night: Mad Surgeon
regiment_28.description:
Movies! I need more movies! Go dig around the [Smuggling Tunnel]—there has to be something good down there.
I hear there's a [laboratory in the northern section]. Now that's a setting for a movie! Find me something about a [mad surgeon] or whatever they keep in places like that.
objectives: Find MAD DOC #1 at Emergency Ladder
Find MAD DOC #2 at Express Lane 2F Office
regiment_28.tips: Both CDs can be found in kitchen.

regiment_27.name: My Favorite: Mosin
regiment_27.description:
My favorite rifle? The [Mosin]. That old thing has history. Every time I run a hand over one, I can almost feel all the battles it's lived through.
Maybe you can challenge some of my old glory. Take a [Mosin], find yourself a good position, wait nice and quiet... then—bang! Give somebody a surprise with that accuracy and power.
regiment_27.tips: Try to roleplay WW2 Soviet partisan for better accuracy. Only [Mosin 91-30](https://www.exfil-zone-assistant.app/items/weapon-mosin-91-30) can have a [scope](https://www.exfil-zone-assistant.app/items/scope_mosinpu).

regiment_37.name: My Favorite: AK
regiment_37.description:
You know why I like the [AK family]? They're not the most accurate rifles in the world, but they're reliable, simple, and perfect when you need plenty of firepower at close to medium range.
I'm sure you've handled [AK-series rifles] before. Time to give them a little more battlefield glory.

regiment_38.name: Movie Night: Metro Thriller
regiment_38.description:
I've watched those movies you brought back so many times already. They're still a blast!
How about checking the [Metro Area] for something new this time? I'd love a [thriller with that underground Metro atmosphere]! I heard someone mention that two movies like that were left behind in the [Military Base Kitchen].
Hmm... maybe I'll get everyone together for this one. Hurry back!

regiment_32.name: One-Time Delivery
regiment_32.description:
I've got an annoying job for you.
Head into the [Metro Area] and collect the [supply crates] from the [Control Room], the [Tank Room], and the [room on the eastern side of the Sewer Area].
To enter the [Tank Room], pull the lever in the [Control Room]. When facing the hound statue, the Control Room is on the second floor to your left.
Then leave them on the [wooden crate outside the hidden room in the sewers].
The hidden room in the sewers is opposite the ladder. You'll need to walk across the pipe suspended overhead. Let's see how nimble you are!
objectives: Place next to the Sewer Hidden Room
regiment_32.tips: [Igor's Supply Case](https://www.exfil-zone-assistant.app/items/taskitem_placement_igor_supplycase). One located on shelf in control room; One located on barrels in large gate room. pull lever in control room to open gate; One located in the east room of sewer area, place task item west of sewer room, two extracts, climb ladder, cross pipe, place on box outside door; items are heavy and might take two trips up ladder

regiment_31.name: My Favorite: Sjogren
regiment_31.description:
Another one of my favorites—the [Sjogren]! That gun was a lifesaver on more adventures than I can count. With one in my hands, there wasn't much I was afraid to face.
Back in the bad old days, it got me out of more than a few ugly situations.
This time, I want you to see what it can do. Take a [Sjogren] into the [Metro Area] and give those scavengers a lesson. Make every shot sound like thunder!
objectives: Sjogren series: Eliminate targets in Metro Area

regiment_17.name: Pistol Glory
regiment_17.description:
Story time. I once had an old buddy who never stopped complaining about his issued pistol. Said the damn thing was nothing but a firecracker—good for noise and maybe scaring cowards.
Then one day we got pinned behind a rock, surrounded, couldn't even stick our heads out. All I had left was the pistol on my hip.
He said we were finished. So I drew that pistol, screamed like a madman, charged out there, and dropped every last one of them! Afterward, he asked me for the gun and carried it with him from then on.
All right, story's over. Now it's your turn to make a [pistol] shine.

regiment_39.name: My Favorite: FAL
regiment_39.description:
Another favorite of mine—the brutal [FAL]! That rifle's like an old friend. It's been with me through more crazy situations than I can remember.
Now I want you to take a [FAL] out and let those bastards hear what it has to say. Don't be shy—enjoy it!
And take an [AKM] with you too. Another battle-tested old bastard. The two belong together. Give them both a proper workout and show me you can handle them.

regiment_40.name: Taste of Life: Red Wine
regiment_40.description:
That last booze you found wasn't bad, but I've got another craving.
I hear the [Wyeth Farmhouse in the Suburb Area] has a proper wine cellar. Good stuff, too! I want you to mark the [large wine barrels in the cellar].
Then keep an eye out around the island for [Wyeth Dry Red Wine] and bring me some intact.
You can try looking at the [Wyeth Farmhouse], [Dam Power Station], and [Hovolt Store].
objectives: Turn in Wyeth's Dry Red Wine

regiment_30.name: Frozen in Time
regiment_30.description:
You know what statues and photographs have in common? They both capture something in a single moment and preserve it forever. Romantic, isn't it?
Go take some pictures of statues around the island for me:
the [brown bear statue in Hyder Town],
the [bull statue at the Flea Market in the Resort Area],
the [angel statue beside Clifton Church],
and the [hound statue in the Metro Area].
objectives: Take photo of the Bear statue
Take photo of the Bull statue
Take photo of the Angel statue
Take photo of the Hound statue
regiment_30.tips: Dam angel located outside church in clifton. Bear located in Hyder town on suburb. Bull located in flea market on resort. Hound on metro top of stairs by east extract

regiment_34.name: Final Challenge
regiment_34.description:
Warrior. Stand straight and listen.
Sometimes the worst enemy you'll ever face is the one inside your own head. Your last challenge is to overcome your fear, hesitation, weakness, and doubt.
Train your will. And this time, I'm not joking. Everything I've asked you to do until now was meant to make you stronger up here.
[I don't care how you do it or what weapon you use. Face overwhelming numbers alone. Challenge yourself—and beat yourself.]

regiment_35.name: Intermission
regiment_35.description:
You did good! Ha! Knew you had it in you. You're almost starting to look like me back in the day.
...
Well? Don't just stand there. Times like this call for a smoke, don't they? Don't worry, I've got the good stuff saved away. You go find me a [lighter]—and don't forget the [fuel].

regiment_10.name: Wastewater Treasure Hunt
regiment_10.description:
I hear things have gotten pretty ugly in the [Resort Area]. That's terrible news—my most precious treasure is still hidden there! My [notebook]!
They say a dull pencil beats a sharp memory, and at my age that notebook is worth more than gold. Go get it back for me! It's inside the [Wastewater Plant on the west side of the Resort Area].

reward.item_name: MOSINM1891 bolt action rifle OBREZ edition

regiment_11.name: For a Friend I
regiment_11.description:
An old friend of mine used to live in the [Resort Area]. Loved messing around with rocks and metal. Personally, I never understood why anyone would choose that over a good rifle. A rifle can protect you!
And speaking of that, those thugs have turned the [Resort Area] into a damn mess. They must be disturbing my friend's rest.
Go [teach those troublemakers a lesson] for me.

regiment_12.name: For a Friend II
regiment_12.description:
That old friend of mine—everyone else called him a legendary jeweler. I always just called him Old Jay.
The greatest treasure from the [bank robbery in the Resort Area], the [Heart of the Blue Sea], was actually his work. After he passed away at [WhiteSail Hospital], he left me a journal mentioning several places.
I want you to visit those locations and [take pictures of the clues] for me.
objectives: Take photo of a clue on the wall (Modern apartment park)
Take photo of a clue on the wall (Halif Voyage backdoor)
Take photo of a clue on the wall (Beach chair area)

regiment_14.name: One More Drink
regiment_14.description:
Know why those thugs still haven't found the [Heart of the Blue Sea]? Old Jay gave it to me a long time ago. I just never saw any reason to advertise that fact.
Do me a favor and visit his [grave beside the Resort Area Lighthouse]. Beer was always his favorite. Take this [beer] and [baseball cap] and leave them there for him.
If you lose the items, you can find or buy replacements in the field.

reward.item_name: MOSIN9130 bolt action rifle INFANTRY edition
Mosin bolt action rifle AKM muzzle adapter

regiment_14.tips: Bring beer to lighthouse on resort, small grave behind, place beer

regiment_18.name: Movie Night: Shark Thriller
regiment_18.description:
You know I like movies with a bit of danger and excitement, but I've watched my own discs to death!
Go have a look around the [Resort Area] and find me a good [shark thriller]. Try [Rua Algasol] and the [fast-food restaurant near the Skate Park]. Maybe somebody left something worth watching.

reward.item_name: Mosin bolt action rifle M1891 barrel rear sight

regiment_18.tips: One on toilet at Skatepark cafe. Second CD on barrel at Rua Algasol.

regiment_25.name: Vacation Time
regiment_25.description:
Ah, these legs aren't what they used to be. Can't exactly go out and enjoy the sun and sea breeze myself anymore.
Listen to me—while your legs still work, enjoy the damn trip! I hear there are [sightseeing trams along the coast in the Resort Area]. Go take some pictures for me.
And make sure they're the ones on the [coastal route]. That's where the view is!
objectives: Take photo of the tram A (Seaglass St)
Take photo of the tram B (Seaglass St)
Take photo of the tram C (Seaglass St)
regiment_25.tips: The tram train cars are located on the road by hotel, two in front of hotel and one located on the road west toward construction.

regiment_29.name: Dress the Part
regiment_29.description:
Sometimes I have to admit, those police boys know how to dress. You put on the uniform, hold up a rifle, and suddenly you're “enforcing the law.”
Hmm... why don't you try it? Put on the [Police PACA Body Armor] and [Beret Hat Black], then go teach a few lawbreakers some manners.
regiment_29.tips: Dress with [Police PACA Body Armor](https://www.exfil-zone-assistant.app/items/armor-police-vest) and [Black Beret](https://www.exfil-zone-assistant.app/items/helmet-beanie-black) and kill 16 targets.

regiment_8.name: SMG Challenge
regiment_8.description:
I once made a bet with a buddy on the battlefield. SMGs only—whoever dropped more enemies won.
But you know what happened? Idiot charged out there and never came back. Probably wandered off somewhere to slack off. No respect for a good wager!
What, you want to know where he is now? Here. This dog tag was his.
So, want to finish the bet for him? [Take down a few scavengers with an SMG].

regiment_41.name: Personal Grooming
regiment_41.description:
A gentleman has standards. Even under miserable survival conditions, I refuse to let my appearance fall apart.
Bring me a few things for personal grooming. This handsome face deserves proper maintenance.
Let's see... one [bottle of shampoo] and one [bottle of beard oil] should do it!

regiment_42.name: Computer Repair
regiment_42.description:
Damn it, my computer broke. I've only been using the thing for twenty years! See? This is why I don't trust electronics.
Fine. Find me a [hard drive], two [computer textbooks], and two [industrial outlets]. I'll fix the damn thing myself.

regiment_15.name: Reading Habit
regiment_15.description:
Hey, you hate power outages? I was reading a magazine just now and suddenly—black as night. Strange. One of these days I'll go see which damn wire is causing the problem myself.
Until then, I need a backup plan. Find me a [flashlight] and [D batteries]. At least then I can keep reading when the power dies.

regiment_16.name: Best Canned Food
regiment_16.description:
Buddy, how about helping an old man satisfy a craving? What I want isn't hard to find—just some canned food. Delicious stuff.
No idea what they put in it, but every time I eat it my tongue gets all numb and tingly... What? Allergic reaction? Nonsense! That's the taste buds waking up!
Bring me a few [cans of peas]. I want to stock up.

regiment_43.name: Different Style
regiment_43.description:
Hey, new guy. Yeah, I'm talking to you. Seen you running errands for that ARK fellow lately.
I've seen the gear he sells. Big-company stuff. Proper, reliable... and boring as hell. Want to try something with a little more character? My suppliers aren't exactly the corporate type.
Here. Take this out for a spin. Put down a few scavengers around the Dam, then come back and tell me what you think.

regiment_44.name: Taste of Life: Beer
regiment_44.description:
Well? Told you my gear was different! Ha! Keeping old Igor happy is a lot easier than dealing with those corporate types—just bring me some decent booze.
There should still be some [beer] at the [convenience store near the Dam]. Bring me a few, but let me warn you: I've got standards. Don't come back with some foul-tasting garbage and expect me to drink it.

regiment_45.name: Explosions Are Romantic
regiment_45.description:
Hey, come closer. I know somebody stashed some [gunpowder] around the [Dam Area]. Don't ask who. Just bring it back for me. It's not stealing if somebody leaves perfectly good gunpowder lying around, right?
Check [Desolage Village] and [Camp #10]. Oh, and the one at the camp is hidden in a [portable toilet]. Don't look at me like that. I have no idea why anyone would hide gunpowder in there either.
Bring it all back. Don't worry—I've already got plans for it. Ha!

regiment_46.name: Blinding Light
regiment_46.description:
Drinking is good. Watching things blow sky-high while you're drinking? Even better! Only problem is, those flashes are damn bright. My eyes are starting to complain.
I left my [sunglasses] in the [workshop at the Dam Logging Site]. Go get them for me. Without those, how am I supposed to enjoy the next big show?

regiment_47.name: Hair Comes First
regiment_47.description:
Hey, what do you think of the hair today? I'll bet you won't find another man around here who looks this good!
Want to learn from the master? Start with the hair. Helmets, hats, all that junk—keep it off your head. Flattens everything!
Go find a few unlucky bastards in Dam Area to practice on. Let's see if you can make it through a fight without ruining the look.
objectives: Eliminate targets without wearing a helmet

regiment_48.name: Work Smarter
regiment_48.description:
Those scavengers out there don't exactly eat well. So why not give them something worth fighting over and let them do the hard work for us?
Take some [sausages] to the [Toll Station in the southwest Dam Area]. Leave them at the [lookout tower] and [Camp #11]. Once those idiots find them... heh. Let them fight over it.

reward.item_name: MOSINM1891 bolt action rifle INFANTRY edition

regiment_49.name: Hunter
regiment_49.description:
The author of this novel I'm reading has definitely never held a rifle. Absolute nonsense!
Let me tell you how it really goes. Before I joined the army, my father took me hunting. Across the river behind the hill, I spotted a dark shape moving through the trees. Thought it was a bear, so I pulled the trigger. Found out later it was a lone enemy soldier who'd fled the battlefield.
Want to try your hand at hunting? [Take down a few scavengers with a bolt-action rifle].

reward.item_name: MOSINM1891 bolt action rifle OBREZ edition

regiment_50.name: Emergency Rations
regiment_50.description:
I'm actually pretty picky about food. Don't give me that look. You live this long, you earn the right to be picky about your canned meat.
I stashed some cans at the [Old Factory in the Dam Area], inside [Building C1] and [Building C2]. They were supposed to be emergency rations for when things got really bad... ah, forget it. I'm hungry now.
Go bring them back. And don't you eat them on the way.
objectives: Find canned food in Factory Sector C1
Find canned food in Factory Sector C2

regiment_51.name: Old Haunts
regiment_51.description:
Come to think of it, I've been to all those [ball courts] around the island—the ones in the [Dam Area], [Suburb Area], and [Resort Area]. Each had its own character.
I used to go get some exercise whenever I had time. But making the rounds again? Looking at pictures sounds a lot less tiring.
Go photograph the [three ball courts] for me. I'll enjoy the memories from right here. Nice and comfortable.
objectives: Take photo of basketball court in Dam Area
Take photo of basketball court in Suburb Area
Take photo of basketball court in Resort Area

ntg_63.name: Messenger
ntg_63.description:
Hey, new face. Snap out of it. I’m Johnny, your contact.
I got word you’d be coming. A guy asked me to pass something along to one of his colleagues. Well, not the package itself. Just a pickup spot.
Judging by the way you’re dressed, I’d say that means you.
Don’t expect me to hand-deliver it, though. This island’s no vacation spot these days. The pickup is on the roof of the Dam Dock Office. You’ll have to go get it yourself.
And be careful with it. That thing is one pricey piece of electronics. Bring it back to me once you’ve got it, and I’ll take care of the rest.
objectives: Find Locked OPS Terminal in Dam

trupiks_22.name: Capacity Upgrade III
trupiks_22.description:
Hey, I burned through those last parts pretty fast. Looks like I'm going to need you to do another run, this time in the [Resort Area].
Check the [LAUNDRY at Workers Dorm] for a special [parts case]. If we're lucky, that'll be enough for me to start building you an even bigger secure container.

trupiks_12.name: The Last Mile
trupiks_12.description:
We've been having more and more security problems along our logistics routes lately. I need to deploy some communications gear at a key point to keep information moving.
Head to the [Resort Area]. Pick up the [radio] in the [back alley behind the Garbage Station], then find the [cardboard-box stash at the skate park] and leave it there. Good luck.
objectives: Place walkie-talkie 1 in the Skate park
Place walkie-talkie 2 in the Skate park
Place walkie-talkie 3 in the Skate park
Place walkie-talkie 4 in the Skate park
Place walkie-talkie 5 in the Skate park

trupiks_23.name: Off the Beaten Path
trupiks_23.description:
You've probably come across a few unusual extraction points while exploring. They require specific rare keys to unlock, so hardly anyone uses them.
I want you to scout them out for me. Use the [required keys] to extract through the [locked extraction points] in the [Dam Area], [Suburb Area], and [Resort Area].

trupiks_14.name: Stockpiling I: Household Goods
trupiks_14.description:
Keeping the facilities running and building new things burns through a lot of supplies, so I'm planning to stock up while we can.
First up: [household goods]. Here's the list. Take a look.

trupiks_15.name: Stockpiling II: Tools
trupiks_15.description:
Thanks for helping me gather all that. Since you've already come this far, mind seeing it through?
The second batch is [tools]. I've got a specific list this time, so make sure they're the right ones. Thanks.

trupiks_16.name: Stockpiling III: Storage Media
trupiks_16.description:
For the third batch, I need [storage media]. Plenty of information still needs to be recorded, and I'm a little picky about what we use for that.
Here's the list. Thanks.

trupiks_17.name: Stockpiling IV: Energy Supplies
trupiks_17.description:
Thanks for sticking with me this far. This is the last batch.
This time, I need [energy supplies]. They're what keep the base's essential facilities running, so you could say they're the most important items on the list.
Same as before—here's what I need. Thanks.

trupiks_24.name: Signal Supply
trupiks_24.description:
Want to try out the latest batch of flare guns? With one of these, you can call in supply crates from certain locations.
1. [Supply site in the Suburb Area]: [Somewhere central, high up, with a good view. Used to be one of the busiest places around.]
2. [Supply site in the Resort Area]: [There's only one way in, and the road ends there. Look for a place surrounded by water.]
3. [Supply site in the Dam Area]: [Head north and find the high-rise that was never finished. The view from up there is hard to miss.]
objectives: Arrive the launch site on Trupiks rooftop
Arrive the launch site on top of Construction Site
Arrive the launch site around Victoria Hotel

trupiks_21.name: Never Too Many Supplies
trupiks_21.description: Flare guns are single-use, and only the fastest one gets to call in the supply drop. Try racing the others to it and successfully call in a supply crate at the [launch site] in the [Resort Area].
objectives: Use flare gun in Resort area launch site

ntg_13.name: Coffee Break
ntg_13.description:
By the way, have you seen any coffee out there? Back when I worked at [Trupiks], I got used to having a cup every day, so I'd say I've gotten pretty damn good at making it.
If you can bring me some [coffee], I promise you'll get the first cup I brew.
ntg_13.tips: Not full Coffee Drinks can be submitted too.

trupiks_25.name: Generator Upgrade
trupiks_25.description:
More and more things around the base are drawing power, and this generator's starting to struggle. Time to give it an upgrade.
We're going to need quite a bit this time. The boiler needs something combustible, the base needs building materials for reinforcement, and I'm still short on a few tools for the wiring.
Keep an eye out while you're in the field and bring back what we need.
objectives: Turn in Combustible Items Found In Raid
Turn in Building Items Found In Raid
Turn in Tools Items Found In Raid

trupiks_1.name: Special Provision
trupiks_1.description:
If you're looking for a steady source of income, my advice is to build and upgrade your Bitcoin farm. It'll draw some power, but it'll generate money for you over time.
Add more graphics cards to the rig and you'll increase the payout. Just remember to keep an eye on the generator's fuel.
While I'm getting things ready, I need you to check whether three locations in the [Suburb Area] are safe: [Hyder Town], the [Power Plant], and the [Warehouse east of the Office Building].
objectives: Reach the warehouses in Suburb area
Reach the power plant in Suburb area
trupiks_1.tips: Power plant is marked on the map, near the western bunker. Warehouses are just east next to the office building.

trupiks_26.name: Capacity Upgrade I
trupiks_26.description:
How's that secure container treating you? After taking a closer look at the design, I think I can build you a bigger one.
I'm guessing you'd like to try it, but I'm missing a few parts for the custom build. I need a special [parts case]. Head to the [Auto Repair Shop] in the [Suburb Area] and see if you can find one.

trupiks_9.name: Canal Run
trupiks_9.description:
I've got a favor to ask. Someone told me they saw some cargo I lost near one of the [canal bridges west of Trupiks].
Problem is, I don't know which bridge it was. I'd like you to check [all of the canal bridges] for me.

trupiks_10.name: Capacity Upgrade II
trupiks_10.description:
I need to recover some pretty specific parts. Trouble is, they all have to come from the exact same model of television.
It's the same model I used to have at home, and I've already found a few of them. Keep checking the [houses in the Suburb Area] for me. If you spot a matching TV, take a picture and I'll handle the recovery.
I'd start with the houses across from the main entrance of [Trupiks Mall], along the road northeast of [Hyder Town], and around the road north of [Unloading Station]. If any of those places have an upper floor or an attic, make sure you check those too.
objectives: Capture TV 1 (Cottage northeast of Hyder Town)
Capture TV 2 (Cottage next to the Northern Tunnel)
Capture TV 3 (Cottage next to the Northern Tunnel)
Capture TV 4 (Yellow-ish house in the North)
trupiks_10.tips: Located at the Workers Dormitory. At the laundry mat.

trupiks_27.name: Energy Saver
trupiks_27.description:
I've got a few friends hiding out in the underground parking garage at Trupiks. They're having a rough time down there, and I want to send them a few things to help out.
Check the houses and convenience stores outside. You might find some [energy-saving bulbs] and [UV lamps] there.
Once you've got them, head to the garage. Place the [energy-saving bulbs] in the [cardboard box near the northeast stairwell], and the [UV lamps] in the [cardboard box near the northwest stairwell].

trupiks_2.name: Supply Check
trupiks_2.description:
Hey, you new here? I'm Johnny. I used to handle logistics at [Trupiks]. These days, I mostly take care of the facilities around here. If there's anything you want built or upgraded, I'm your guy.
Speaking of supplies, there used to be a supply point by the coast in the [Suburbs], near a [Supply Truck]. We used to move a lot of cargo through there. No idea how much is left now, though. If you've got the time, go take a look.
objectives: Find the Supply Truck in the southwest

trupiks_3.name: Let There Be Light
trupiks_3.description:
I've checked the generator. The main components are still intact—the problem's in the wiring and a few worn-out parts. Good news is, I can fix all of that.
What I'm still missing are a few decent tools. Once you find some out there, take them out of your backpack and place them on the [conveyor belt nearby]. I'll collect them from there.
objectives: Turn in Tools Items Found In Raid

trupiks_28.name: Old Faithful
trupiks_28.description:
The generator wiring still needs some work. You know, back when I worked at [Trupiks], I had this power drill I'd been using for years. Never let me down.
The [Unloading Station behind Trupiks] used to be under our logistics department. We had to leave in a hurry when everything went bad, so the drill should still be somewhere around there.
Go see if you can find it and bring the old thing back to me. Once I've got it, finishing the generator should be a whole lot easier.

trupiks_29.name: Getting into Gunsmithing
trupiks_29.description:
Want to try modifying a gun yourself? Start by buying an MP5K. It's a good one to learn on.
The magazine goes straight in—easy enough. If you want to mount an optic, check whether the gun has a rail first. If it doesn't, you'll need to install one before the optic can go on.
For anything more complicated, you'll need the [Gunsmith Bench]. Get comfortable with the basics first. Later on, you can start fine-tuning a weapon that really feels right in your hands.

trupiks_30.name: First Supply Run
trupiks_30.description:
There's a lot around the base that needs fixing, and I'm starting to run low on materials.
You should still be able to find something useful at [Altibuy] and the [Auto Repair Shop] in the [Suburbs]. Nails, duct tape, bolts—anything like that. Bring back whatever building materials you can find. I'll put them to good use.
objectives: Turn in Building Items Found In Raid

trupiks_31.name: Building the Range
trupiks_31.description:
Hey, buddy. I was going through some old stuff and found the plans for the hideout. Turns out I finally figured out how to get the [shooting range behind the building] open.
I still need one little favor from you, though. Head to [Hyder Town] and bring me the [small key] from the [first-floor office in the police station]. I know that's nothing you can't handle. Good luck out there.
objectives: Reach the Hyder Town Police Station

trupiks_32.name: Home Sweet Home
trupiks_32.description:
Tommy tells me you're heading to [Hyder Town] soon. The [first house by the eastern entrance] used to be mine, and I left an important [family videotape] there.
If you're going after Iron Wolf anyway, could you pick it up for me on the way? I've packed some supplies for you. Don't forget to grab them before you head out.

trupiks_33.name: Investigate the Hard Drive
trupiks_33.description:
This is an interesting piece of equipment. The internal layout is unusual too. You do not see a design like this every day.
I have unlocked the OPS Terminal. It is yours now. I sent it to your mailbox, so do not forget to pick it up.
Boot it up, and you will find the clues Caleb left behind before he disappeared.
One more thing: if you lose the terminal, come back to me. Slip me a little tip, and I can make you another one.
objectives: Insert terminal into Agent PC in Dam
Insert terminal into Agent PC in Suburbs
Insert terminal into Agent PC in Resort
Open safe and find Investigation Drive

trupiks_34.name: Upgrade Terminal: Signal Tracking
trupiks_34.description:
That investigation log you brought back says Caleb may have gotten himself into trouble.
If you want to find him, you’ll need to unlock the OPS Terminal’s signal tracking first. Caleb planted quite a few listening devices around the island, and those devices leave traceable signals behind.
Problem is, terminal needs tracking upgrade module before it can lock onto those signal sources one by one.
Scavengers in the Dam area might be carrying them. Go get a few and bring them back to me. I’ll upgrade your terminal.
objectives: Eliminate SCAVs at Dam, turn in Upgrade Module

trupiks_35.name: Signal Tracking
trupiks_35.description:
Those upgrade modules you brought back did the trick. Terminal"s upgrade went smoothly.
You can now use its tracking system to look for traces of your colleague.
Bring out OPS terminal near a signal source, and it’ll start tracking. Get close to a listening device, and terminal can read the full data.
Just keep in mind, the tracking range is limited. Get too far away, and the signal disappears completely.
objectives: Decrypt listening device with OPS Terminal
Decrypt listening device with OPS Terminal
Decrypt listening device with OPS Terminal

trupiks_36.name: Transport Route
trupiks_36.description:
You’re telling me there’s an extremely dangerous virus sample on the island now? And Caleb’s dead?
Tch... let me make one thing clear. I’m not refunding that fat stack of money he paid me back then. Hmm... I’ve got a new suit for you. You can try it on in the restroom.
Still, seeing as things have really gone sideways, I can give you a little help. Find their transport route map and bring it to me. I’ll figure out where they took that thing.
Your clues have been updated. Open terminal and take a look.
objectives: Eliminate Ringleader, turn in Transport Route Map

trupiks_37.name: DT83 Virus
trupiks_37.description:
Well, look at that. You actually followed the trail and found a lead on the sample.
I asked Maggie about it. Once the sample leaves cold storage, its activity starts degrading, so the handoff needs to happen as soon as possible.
Terminal's been updated with the latest information on the virus sample. Go check it.
objectives: Open lockbox and find Animal Cipher Codebook
Find UV Flashlight on B1 of Mall
Find the UV Flashlight in the Subway

trupiks_38.name: Caleb's Keepsake
trupiks_38.description:
Marcus, the mission’s over. But there’s something I never told you.
Caleb... left a letter on the hard drive. Wrote it just for you.
Open terminal and take a look.
